nonduplicate_scope.existing_scope: 10 TRAIN-only rows across 5 integrated multi-process trajectory families
nonduplicate_scope.this_delta: census-wide process-level supervision across all 13 blueprint families with explicit OOD family splits and fully crossed visible nuisance controls
nonduplicate_scope.reason: Integrated trajectories teach composition; this generator isolates process semantics and variable-grid nuisance invariance. Neither replaces Lane-A dynamic S3 binding or packet/ABI projection supervision.

swarm_roles.result: Produced an initial 52-row process-level design over 13 census-derived blueprint families.
REJECTED v0 because process-family identifiers were model-visible and could become a semantic shortcut.
REJECTED v0 because N, executor and presentation were coupled rather than independently controlled.
Replaced generic accept/reject prose with structured next-state targets containing required output contracts and explicit candidate-only authority fences.
Detected existing integrated cognitive trajectory seed v4 and narrowed this work to complementary census-wide atomic process semantics rather than creating a competing Lane-B corpus.
Observed new 8.78 rule after v3 nuisance leak evidence: randomized or pairwise-balanced visible factors are insufficient; use a full cross or a preregistered conditional-independence gate.
Expanded to the full 2x2x2 N x executor x presentation cross per semantic case and process family, with process/ZECP identity evaluator-only.

parallel_negative_evidence_ingested.research_rule: Marginal balance does not establish shortcut independence; model-visible nuisance schedules require higher-order/conditional checks.

training_rules_returned_to_clay_research: Dynamic episode-local S3 binding is a narrow measured micro-skill and must not substitute for the full EntityOS cognitive-process curriculum.
Process-family and ZECP identifiers belong in evaluator/provenance metadata, not in model-visible prompts, unless identity itself is intentionally the task input.
Randomized presentation and marginal class/target balance do not establish nuisance independence.
Visible nuisance variables should be fully crossed when cheap enough; otherwise use a preregistered conditional nuisance decoder/MI gate.
Integrated multi-process trajectories and atomic process-semantic examples are complementary evaluation/training levels and should be scored separately.
Candidate training rows can teach method and fail-closed boundaries without minting facts, canonical state, effect authority or J-Space causal labels.
harness_implications: Score atomic process-state transition correctness separately from integrated trajectory completion and opaque-symbol binding accuracy.
Add full-cross N/executor/presentation invariance slices and resize-during-task slices.
Keep evaluator family/process labels outside model-visible input.
Run nuisance-only decoders and conditional MI/signature-support checks, not only marginal balance tests.
Score OOD transfer to held-out process families separately from in-family retention.
Fail closed on canonical-state/effect-authority violations even when task-semantic accuracy is otherwise high.
known_limits: CP10-CP11 are validation-only and CP12-CP13 holdout-only in this OOD seed, so it is not the final all-process training mixture.
A final corpus needs split-disjoint within-process causal families so all required processes can receive TRAIN coverage while OOD transfer remains measurable.
Lane-A/Lane-C opaque-symbol targets still require exact verified accepted ABI atom identities and tokenizer/evidence byte binding before production-like materialization.
No fine-tuning, local model inference, J-Space intervention or provider execution occurred in this cycle.
next_exact_actions: Create split-disjoint within-process semantic families so all 13 required cognitive processes have TRAIN examples without contaminating validation/holdout.
Repair the retained binding-router v3 schedule to full-cross or preregistered conditional-independence acceptance before any direct training use.
Add selective Lane-C S3 overlays only where a cognitive transition is naturally ternary and only after exact ABI atoms are byte-bound.
Freeze base-model process, N-invariance, DB-boundary, Claude-bridge, binding, packet-projection and retention eval packets before selecting a training mixture.
